summary: Of 22 candidates, 6 were confirmed, 15 corrected, 0 refuted and 1 unverified (A-05: the deployed frame-extraction limit lives outside both repositories). The most important corrections are to severity: A-01 is friction, not untrue, because the introduction emails say to write to the address shown; E-03 and E-04 drop to P1, since E-03 needs a site's private owner link and a company answer (neither exists in production) and PR 1369 is unmerged and behind a flag that is off. G-01 is real but hits jobs whose simulation was never made, not finished jobs; the count is 3 upload sessions, not 6; and removing the authority_ended close outright would also drop source-revoked and owner-closed endings. Several proposals would break something: A-09 would remove the success definition the task context and company page read, G-06 would let introductions go out under a rights hold, and M-03 and O-12 miss that the cookie banner gates a live first-party analytics ingest.

new_findings.today: Once a job is listed, the site reads 'Posted for approved deployment companies'. In production the only approved company has no signed-in Terms acceptance, so companyMaySeeJobs is false, auto-send finds no company and no company can open the job. The site waits for responses that cannot come.
new_findings.should: The job page says the job is posted only when at least one approved company can see it; otherwise it says the job is ready and Blueprint is still approving companies.
new_findings.proposal: Make sharing.state 'visible' also require at least one robotTeamAccess record for which companyMaySeeJobs holds (the same filter jobAutoSend uses); otherwise show a 'ready, no company can see it yet' line. Separately, the owner asks the approved company to sign in and accept the Terms.
new_findings.user_result: A site is never told its job is in front of companies when it is not.
new_findings.risk: A count query per page view; cache it. No privacy, rights or money record changes.
new_findings.verify_how: Code read plus production aggregate counts; did not open a real job page.
